Content: “All the dregs of humanity produced in the provinces make up the population of this city, and in this lies its greatness: not in fine buildings, and not in great merchants and thinkers and men of letters, as make Paris, London, Lisbon, and Amsterdam great cities; but in those of the lowest behavior and dishonesty, who, by intermarrying increase and multiply so that `text(each generation)` is worse than the `text(one)` before.”
Copyright: Bernardo Tanucci, satirical description of his home city of Naples, Italy, Epistolario, `text(1742)`
